No production code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation, or cache storage paths are modified. The rest of the supplied file is unchanged context: scripted CBv2Engine stubs, a stub container, and KV re-slice and slot-build tests. The tests use no network, no weights, and no real secrets. The change does not weaken any threat-model control (T-041, TB-007, A-001). The unit-level change is benign. One integration question remains outside this file: where `.toolCallDelta` is introduced and how production code handles those events. Its handling affects whether streamed tool-call content is encrypted and emitted correctly (T-008). That is not visible in the supplied units, and this test file ignoring the events is not a security issue. No findings.
